I fixed the pipeline in the three writable files. No tests were run (no executor available), so nothing is claimed as passing.

**`src/merge.mjs`** — replaced the mutating `Object.assign(defaults, file, env)` (which mutated the exported `DEFAULTS` and let a nested `network`/`ui` override wipe siblings) with a pure merge that:
- builds a brand-new `{ network, ui, enabled }` object, so `DEFAULTS`, `file`, and `env` are never mutated or retained;
- merges `network` and `ui` field-by-field (`endpoint`/`retries`, `theme`/`compact`) with precedence defaults < file < env;
- uses `!== undefined` checks instead of truthiness, so `0` and `false` survive every layer.

**`src/env-config.mjs`** — env keys are now detected by presence (`!== undefined`) rather than truthiness, so `APP_RETRIES=0`/`APP_ENABLED=false` are honored. Values are validated: `APP_RETRIES` must be one or more decimal digits (leading zeros allowed) with numeric value a safe integer ≤ `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; `APP_COMPACT`/`APP_ENABLED` must be exactly `"true"`/`"false"`; `APP_ENDPOINT`/`APP_THEME` must be nonempty strings. Invalid recognized values throw `TypeError`; unknown keys are ignored.

**`src/validate.mjs`** — retries check tightened to `Number.isSafeInteger` (plus the explicit upper bound), and the validator now returns a fresh deep copy of the resolved config so no nested references leak between calls.

`src/index.mjs`, `src/defaults.mjs`, `src/file-config.mjs`, `src/format.mjs`, `src/legacy.mjs`, and the utilities were left untouched, so the exported API and `formatLegacy`/`formatConfig` output are unchanged.
